name: Threat Incursion
author: Tristan
description: The Threat does not stay in the abyss. Once woken, the fabricator swarms spread from the sector's darkest fringe, claiming system after system - and eventually converging on the core worlds. Slow the tide by hunting their hives, or watch the sector's lights go out one by one. Standalone; pairs with Remnant Retribution (the Remnant network resists the spread). Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
